description: Writes the real date, time and timezone of your campaign into the thank-you page, where a fixed text still shows an old one. Take it when a participant registers and then reads the wrong day: "Someone told me the page says last month." It needs the session and the webinar. Only the date line on that page changes, no other wording and no campaign field. The answer keeps the previous line, so the same call can put it back. A preflight check tells you whether such a deviation exists at all. For any other line on that page there is a separate tool. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: wrong date, thank-you page, old date on page, date fix, registration page date

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.
